answer: Hardware attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to generate keys inside a secure enclave. Instead of letting bot clusters entangle peers like a vine, nodes verify cryptographic proofs signed by physical silicon. An attacker incurs the cost of buying distinct microprocessors rather than deploying a cheap river of virtual clones. A major limitation is that relying on manufacturer root keys creates a brittle karst trust model vulnerable to hardware side-channel exploits.
